_comment: AB#4729: the 30-second store trailer, cut by apps/web/tools/make-trailer.mjs. Each footage shot names a segment of video/segments.json and one of its clips ('clip', default 0), which names the raw recording, and a range within that recording. Record fresh footage of the current build first (apps/web/tools/record.mjs <url> video/build/raw). No caption is burned in: 'caption' is the cue written to video/trailer.vtt for YouTube.

shots.caption: Forge a relic. Drag one onto its twin.
Two of a kind become one older relic. Quick chains build combos. No energy: the forge never locks.
Open chests. Their odds are always shown.
Relic Vault. Free to play, with optional purchases.
